question: Can a bounded self-improving forecaster reduce unseen-origin pinball loss for posted GPU rental-price quantiles relative to the official drift baseline?
hypothesis: A trailing conformal interval calibrated only from history available at each origin will reduce checkpoint mean pinball loss relative to drift without increasing development loss.
primary_metric: Paired mean cell pinball-loss difference versus the parent forecaster, with a 90% origin-block bootstrap confidence interval
baseline: Official starter drift forecast; last_value remains the skill denominator
stop_condition: Stop after two improver cycles, or earlier when no candidate passes the frozen checkpoint acceptance rule.

dataset.name: gpu-price-pack
